rules: every field is {value, definition_status, sources[], raw, null_reason, question, note}; value null => null_reason and question are set
values are copied from read-only sources; nothing is computed from Test/Control; analysis_setup_mixpanel = how the Mixpanel analysis is set up, not confirmed live config
stop_reason applies to stopped tests only; live tests carry null with null_reason "test is live"
related_unlinked = possibly related source mentions that are NOT linked to the test until a person confirms
priority_tier: live / stopped (board status Aborted or Stopped) / recent_ended (end >= 2026-08-04) / ended / backlog; backlog records use board columns only (fill_scope stage2_board_columns_only)
owners = board person columns (Analyst/Economist or Test/Analysis/Economy Owner); questions go to them
see field_definitions.<field>.stage2_fill_rule for how each field was filled

test_change.definition: What is different for the Test group, in the source wording.
test_change.source: per record: fields.<name>.sources[] (type, ref, locator = column id / tab cell / file:line, read_at)
test_change.stage2_fill_rule: Stage 2: the "Test - ..." / "Test Group: ..." line, Domino "Treatment" column, or a Hebrew "קבוצת הטסט מקבלת ..." sentence (explicit); a "Description:" line (explicit, noted); registry summary => interpretation.

control_gets.source: per record: fields.<name>.sources[] (type, ref, locator = column id / tab cell / file:line, read_at)
control_gets.stage2_fill_rule: Stage 2: the "Control - ..." line or "קבוצת הקונטרול ..." sentence; registry summary => interpretation.

audience.new_vs_old.definition: new / old / both (as set in the named source); raw holds the cut-off definition.
audience.new_vs_old.source: per record: fields.<name>.sources[] (type, ref, locator = column id / tab cell / file:line, read_at)
audience.new_vs_old.stage2_fill_rule: Stage 2: keyword match ("new users", "old users", "New/old") on audience text or the item name; raw keeps the text.

audience.payer_level.definition: Payer condition of the test population (e.g., non-payers, payers, all), in source wording.
audience.payer_level.source: per record: fields.<name>.sources[] (type, ref, locator = column id / tab cell / file:line, read_at)
audience.payer_level.stage2_fill_rule: Stage 2: payer wording (NPU, non-paying, payers, VIP, FTD, funnelists) quoted from audience text.

audience.platform.definition: Platform(s) in the test (Android / iOS / both).
audience.platform.source: per record: fields.<name>.sources[] (type, ref, locator = column id / tab cell / file:line, read_at)
audience.platform.stage2_fill_rule: Stage 2: android / ios named in audience text or item name.

audience.country.definition: Country condition of the test population.
audience.country.source: per record: fields.<name>.sources[] (type, ref, locator = column id / tab cell / file:line, read_at)
audience.country.stage2_fill_rule: Stage 2: "Countries - ..." list or a named country in audience text / item name / Mixpanel card.

exposure_pct.definition: Share of users in Test, in % as stated by the source. Never derived by us from a group formula; raw keeps the formula.
exposure_pct.source: per record: fields.<name>.sources[] (type, ref, locator = column id / tab cell / file:line, read_at)
exposure_pct.stage2_fill_rule: Stage 2: only when a % for the Test group is written (e.g. "Test Group (50%)", "Test 70%", "50/50"); several different Test % values or several test groups => null + raw; ABTest/modulo formulas are never converted.

lever.definition: One of price / offer / value / purchase_flow / difficulty / reward / screen, only when a source states it or a person confirms it.
lever.source: per record: fields.<name>.sources[] (type, ref, locator = column id / tab cell / file:line, read_at)
lever.stage2_fill_rule: Stage 2: only board Type label "Pricing" -> price and "Offer"/"Offers" -> offer (raw keeps the label); one test (DOM-1621 8 box) set from a WhatsApp launch message stating only a price difference. Other labels => null + question.

primary_metric.definition: The metric the test decision is based on, as named in the source.
primary_metric.source: per record: fields.<name>.sources[] (type, ref, locator = column id / tab cell / file:line, read_at)
primary_metric.stage2_fill_rule: Stage 2: Dice "KPI" and Disney "Primary KPI" columns are explicit; Domino "KPI Focus" is a focus area, kept only in raw; registry text => interpretation.

guardrails.definition: Metrics that must not drop, as named in the source.
guardrails.source: per record: fields.<name>.sources[] (type, ref, locator = column id / tab cell / file:line, read_at)
guardrails.stage2_fill_rule: Stage 2: Disney "Defensive KPI" column is read as guardrails (split on commas). Dice/Domino boards have no such column.

hypothesis.definition: The test hypothesis, in source wording.
hypothesis.source: per record: fields.<name>.sources[] (type, ref, locator = column id / tab cell / file:line, read_at)
hypothesis.stage2_fill_rule: Stage 2: explicit only from a "Hypothesis" column; a "Reason:/Objective:" line in a test description, the Dice "Test Goal" column or a registry summary => definition_status interpretation.

compliance_requirement.definition: yes / no / unknown: whether the test is required by a platform/legal rule, with the source.
compliance_requirement.source: per record: fields.<name>.sources[] (type, ref, locator = column id / tab cell / file:line, read_at)
compliance_requirement.stage2_fill_rule: Stage 2: no source states a requirement => "unknown" + question for every test.

stop_reason.definition: For stopped tests only: the stop reason as written in the source. Live tests: null with null_reason "test is live".
stop_reason.source: per record: fields.<name>.sources[] (type, ref, locator = column id / tab cell / file:line, read_at)
stop_reason.stage2_fill_rule: Stage 2: only for tests whose board status is Aborted/Stopped (26). Quoted from Monday "Test Results"/"Decision Summary", Monday updates or WhatsApp extracts; a decision with numbers but no stated reason => null + raw + question. Not-stopped ended and backlog tests => not_applicable.

records.name: 1109 - Less Trail energy in OOTE RV

test_change.value: מקבלים מחצית מהטרייל אנרג'י שהיה עד היום + רולים
test_change.raw: סיכום טסט LESS TRAIL ENERGY IN OOTE RV תזכורת - קבוצת הטסט מקבלים מחצית מהטרייל אנרג'י שהיה עד היום + רולים. לדוגמה אם בקונטרול מקבלים 60 אנרגיה אז בטסט יראו 30 אנרגיה ו-15 רולים. תוצאות - הטסט מפסיד בגרוס / נט / הכנסות מ-RV. מצד שני מנצח ב-PU. אף אחד מהמדדים לא מובהק. כמות מסיימי טרייל יומית נמוכה ב-14%. בבדיקת מובהקות ברמת משתמש הטסט דווקא מנצח בהכנסות (בסבירות של 65%). בטסט רואים 13% פחות פרסומות ומאבדים רק 2% הכנסות מפרסומות. זה אומר שצמצמנו אביוז של ההצעה. אין יוצאי דופן בפילוח בין קינגדומים. המלצה: טסט זניח ולא מאד מובהק, והמובן מאליו הוא לעשות אבורט. אף על פי כן אני מרגיש בנוח עם דיפלו…

stop_reason.raw: The test is fairly flat. Differences in REV, DAU and PU are all very minor. Completion rates and item 11 usage are identical in both groups. The test group shows a slightly higher average balance at level start. This is most likely because test players got one large reward at once instead of several small ones, which pulls the average up. Recommendation: Since neither group performed better, we can alternate between the two experiences.
